title: Write a research brief with citations
sub: An agent searches and drafts; a fixed check asks one question of every citation before it ships.

nodes.l: Check: does the section say it?

steps.d:
"Brief: how has the vendor security-disclosure window changed
in the last year, and what triggered the change?"
→ search("vendor disclosure window change this year")
3 passages. They give the new window. Nothing says why it changed.

steps.h: The agent opens a source before relying on it
The agent decides it has enough and drafts
steps.d:
"The window moved from 90 to 45 days [advisory-2026-14#3],
after a coordinated-disclosure group's public letter
earlier this year [advisory-2026-14#3]."

steps.h: One sentence fails the check; code sends it back
steps.d:
sentence 2 cites #3, which gives the new window but
not a reason. "Not supported by the cited section."
Code returns that sentence, and only that one.

steps.h: The agent searches again for the missing claim
steps.d: → search("why disclosure window shortened this year")
2 passages. One names the letter and the date.

steps.h: The agent rewrites the sentence; code re-checks it
steps.d:
"...after a coordinated-disclosure group's public letter
in February [advisory-2026-14#1]."

steps.h: Every citation passes; code releases the brief
steps.d: Both sentences now match their cited sections. Brief ships.
